node_profile: z < Moho: evaluate the governed layer-1 polynomial at that node's depth
Moho <= z <= LAB: evaluate the governed layer-2 polynomial at that node's depth
temperature_rule.material_properties: select active phase independently at each node, then FEM-interpolate continuous scalar properties with the same weights
temperature_rule.discrete_ids: diagnostic nodal values only; never interpolate or synthesize an integration-point material ID

prohibitions: do not fit or compress ARCANA profiles into legacy geothC/geothM cubics
do not average, smooth, or select a single node
do not apply temLim clipping to ARCANA temperatures
do not alter stock thermal behavior
required_gates: T_IP at weights (1,0,0) equals node 1 temperature
temperature continuity at every nodal Moho
temperature continuity at every nodal LAB
homogeneous element reproduces homogeneous nodal profile
mixed element temperature and continuous properties finite and bounded by nodal values
discrete material IDs are not interpolated
missing or malformed ARCANA package fails closed

remaining_legacy_consumers: FillIn geothC/geothM construction and Squeez call
Viscos/Diamnd legacy profile and temLim paths
Fixed fault path through legacy Squeez
implementation_boundary.activation_handshake: S1B_I_RUNTIME_LIFECYCLE_IMPLEMENTED; valid candidate loads then aborts with ARCANA_S1B_CONSUMERS_NOT_YET_ENABLED
